t1fw4hy6.baseName: Christmas Tree World 10ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
t1fw4hy6.variantName: Christmas Tree World 10ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
t1fw4hy6.sourceDescription: Enjoy a festive glow with the 10ft Pre-lit Wildhorn Pine. This beautifully full artificial Christmas tree combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 900 multi-function warm white LED lights, creating an impressive centrepiece for your Christmas celebrations. Featuring distinctive short-cut pine needle foliage, the Wildhorn Pine has traditional PVC tips tucked towards the centre. These add depth and fullness, while the outer branches give a natural appearance. There is plenty of foliage to showcase your favourite decorations. It has gently upswept branches and a classic, tapered shape, with natural green shades and subtle brown detailing. At 10ft tall, it makes a striking feature in rooms with high ceilings and spacious entrance halls. Warm white LEDs highlight the needles, with multiple lighting effects to suit your display. The tree comes in five sections, with hinged branches for easy assembly and a supportive metal stand. Spread inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles. Designed for indoor use only, with Christmas Tree World's 10-year foliage and branch guarantee and a 1-year guarantee on the lights. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 10ft • Pre-lit: 900 multi-function warm white LED lights • Number of branch tips: 3,568 • Foliage: Realistic pine needle outer branches with traditional PVC tips towards the centre for added fullness • Foliage colour: Natural green • Tree width: 155cm diameter • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches and five tree sections • Base: Metal stand measuring 120cm in diameter • Includes gloves to wear during assembly • Indoor use only • Guarantee: 10 years on foliage and branches, plus 1 year on the lights • Supplied in two cartons • Carton 1: 125cm × 42cm × 44cm; weight: 18.75kg • Carton 2: 120cm × 34cm × 36cm; weight: 20.65kg • Combined carton weight: 39.4kg • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

hs57hty0.sourceDescription: The Arbor Ultima Half Tree is one of the highest quality and most realistic trees available on the market today. Its beautiful design and truly remarkable amount of masterfully created PE branch tips in a fresh "new-shoot green" makes this tree the ultimate artificial Christmas tree. q38pnrdd.sourceDescription: This Modern Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree serves as a perfect addition to your festive decor, whether placed in the living room or as part of your garden festivities. Its simple, cone-shaped design offers a contemporary twist, combining minimal ornamentation with a functional approach that complements any modern interior. The adaptable nature of this tree makes it an ideal fit for both small apartments and expansive holiday settings, providing a centerpiece that captivates without overwhelming the surrounding space. High-Quality Materials Crafted from durable PVC, this tree boasts longevity and resilience, allowing it to withstand the wear of seasonal setup and storage. The PVC material gives the tree a realistic density, closely mimicking the appearance of natural fir while offering flame-resistant properties for added safety. This ensures that your decor remains both attractive and secure throughout the festive season. Effortless Lighting Equipped with LED strip lights boasting a warm white hue, the tree illuminates your space with a comforting glow. The flexible nature of these lights allows you to position them precisely, enhancing the aesthetic without the frustration of tangled wires. Designed for energy efficiency, these LEDs contribute to an economical holiday display that can brighten any room or garden. User-Friendly Assembly The tree features hinged branches that allow for straightforward assembly, requiring no additional tools besides a screwdriver for the initial setup. This design enables a hassle-free experience, letting you focus more on decoration and less on complicated processes. With clear instructions, the setup is seamless, requiring minimal effort from two people. Versatile Use Designed for both indoor and outdoor settings, this tree adapts to various holiday themes and locations. Its understated elegance allows for creative decoration —whether you're adding traditional ornaments or modern embellishments. The USB power source ensures convenient placement, without the need for proximity to a wall outlet. Care and Longevity When not in use, it is recommended to cover the tree to protect it from dust and elements, ensuring it retains its quality year after year. By following proper care instructions, you can enjoy the tree's beauty season after season without significant wear or deterioration, maintaining its novel appearance and functionality. This will make it much easier to put up the tree in the perfect shape, and will save you time as well. sxny9j6n.baseName: Christmas Tree World 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Blue Tinsel
sxny9j6n.variantName: Christmas Tree World 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Blue Tinsel
sxny9j6n.sourceDescription: Create a bold and colourful Christmas display with our 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Blue Tinsel. Combining a full 8-ply construction with an impressive 12cm thickness, it provides substantially more volume and coverage than standard tinsel, making it particularly effective for larger Christmas trees and festive displays. The vibrant metallic blue finish combines fine and wider reflective strands to create a full, textured appearance with plenty of festive sparkle. The rich blue colour stands out beautifully against traditional green Christmas foliage and is ideal for creating everything from contemporary colour schemes to striking large-scale displays. Supplied in a generous continuous 50m length, you can use the tinsel as one long run or simply cut it into the individual lengths required for your display. This makes it particularly useful for larger decorating projects and allows multiple areas to be decorated without having to join together lots of shorter retail-sized lengths. jh508c8v.sourceDescription: This Christmas tree skirt makes your Christmas tree look more luxurious. So, you can put decorative items you like on it. This soft and warm tree base features snow patterns, which match the festival atmosphere. It also comes with matching Christmas sock, which can be filled with candy, gifts, etc. The tree decoration is easy to fold when not in use, and you can use it next year. Product Specifications Colour: Yellow Material: Fabric (100% polyester) Diameter: 90 cm Middle hole diameter: 10 cm Easy to fold Features snow pattern Includes a Christmas sock This christmas tree skirt is designed solely for domestic holiday decoration and floor protection. To prevent severe fire hazards or property damage, never allow the fabric to come into direct contact with open flames, hot candles, or exposed electrical wiring from holiday lights. Inspect all tree light strands for frayed cords before placing them near the skirt. Ensure the skirt is laid completely flat around the base of the tree stand to avoid creating a dangerous tripping hazard for residents or guests. Do not block access to water reservoirs on live trees. This seasonal textile product is not a toy; keep all decorative ties, metallic trim, small sequins, and plastic packaging completely out of the reach of infants, small children, and pets.
